resources.string: This unprivileged app reads 12 fixed, app-visible checks: Android build metadata, this app’s identity and install-source category, its SELinux context, five fixed file identifiers, selected process and mount fields, and heuristic emulator indicators. It does not access accounts, package inventory, network, contacts, location, or clipboard, and it does not inspect existing user files. Nothing runs until you press Start. This app does not certify device security.
I understand the scope and limitations.
Collection complete. Review the categorized outcomes, limitations, redactions, and exact artifact before export.
Collection partial. At least one check was inaccessible or errored; this is a capability boundary, not a device verdict.
Collection failed with a categorized internal error. No raw exception or path is shown. You may try again.
Collection stopped when the app left the foreground. Return to the app and start again.

• Results show only this unprivileged app sandbox’s view.
• File checks cover five fixed identifiers only; they are not a filesystem search.
• Inaccessible, unsupported, and error outcomes do not mean that evidence is absent.
• Emulator indicators are heuristics; no indicator does not establish a physical device.
• The collection is a bounded measurement, not a trusted/untrusted verdict, score, attestation, or certification.
These transformations are applied before the preview and export:
Build fingerprint replaced with a SHA-256 hash
File paths replaced with fixed logical identifiers
Installer package reduced to a category
Mount fields restricted to an allowlist
Choose a local folder for the reviewed export archive
Choose a local folder. No broad access is retained.
Staging, writing, verifying, and publishing the export…
Export complete. The verified archive was published under its unique name.
Export failed closed. Any temporary document was removed when the provider allowed it; you may retry.
